page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, and relies on a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics are relatively weak, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance scoring 1108.19 and Geekbench single-core scoring 945.0, both placing in the bottom 25% of tested systems. Single-threaded gzip compression is poor at 19.08 GB/sec, falling into the bottom 10%. However, the instance demonstrates average multi-core capabilities. The stress-ng multi-core CPU score is 23515.32, and the Geekbench multi-core score is 8272.0, both aligning with the middle 50% of tested systems. Memory bandwidth is also average, with read-only large block speeds reaching 98.48 GB/sec and write speeds at 49.01 GB/sec.

Given the 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and the dedicated CPU allocation, this instance is structured for general-purpose workloads that benefit from parallel processing rather than high single-threaded speed. It achieves average performance in database operations with a Passmark database score of 8596.21, Redis SET operations at 22.12 million operations per second, and static web serving at 13.89 GB/sec. It also supports moderate machine learning tasks, processing 40.76 tokens per second for prompt processing on a 7B LLM model. The primary tradeoff is the lower single-core efficiency, making it less suitable for single-threaded applications, while its dedicated resources offer stable multi-threaded execution.
